name: Next Meeting
description: Your next appointment on the bar, from any calendar with an ICS address (Google, Outlook, iCloud, Nextcloud, Fastmail) — no OAuth, no API key

calendars.description: ICS addresses (the secret iCal/ICS URL of a calendar, webcal:// works too) or paths to local .ics files, comma-separated

remindMinutes.description: Popup this many minutes before an event starts; 0 switches reminders off

lookaheadDays.description: How many days ahead the flyout and the agent commands list
